entities.name: Mehmet Nadir Ünal
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mehmet Nadir Ünal is a Turkish kickboxer specialized in the K-1 event, and amateur boxer competing in the light heavyweight (-81 kg) division. He is a member of Fenerbahçe Boxing in Istanbul.
